articles.title: Meet LEANN: An Open-Source Vector Index that Shrinks a 60M-Chunk RAG Index from 201 GB to 6 GB
articles.reason: LEANN offers a practical solution for reducing RAG index storage costs, directly impacting enterprise-scale agentic workflows and retrieval systems.
articles.summary: LEANN is an open-source vector index that dramatically reduces storage requirements for large RAG systems by pruning the graph and recomputing embeddings at query time. It achieves near HNSW accuracy with a fraction of the memory footprint, which is highly relevant for consultants managing large-scale retrieval pipelines on Azure. The trade-off is slower search speed, but the storage savings could enable more cost-effective deployments for enterprise clients.
actionable_insights: Evaluate LEANN for integration into existing RAG pipelines to reduce infrastructure costs.
Benchmark LEANN's performance and accuracy against current vector index solutions in Azure environments.
